name: io.github.7shep/universal
description: An AI art director for React interfaces: discovery, creative brief, art direction, Design Plan v2, and implementation review.

environmentVariables.name: UNIVERSAL_WORKSPACE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory the runtime owns for generated project workspaces. Defaults to ~/.universal/workspaces. Must be outside any repository checkout.

environmentVariables.name: UNIVERSAL_REPOSITORY_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Checkout the runtime must refuse to materialize into. Defaults to the installed package directory.
